description: This PHP source file defines a testable subclass of the CalendarSync class, which includes dependency injection features, test double support, and singleton management functions. It is used for unit testing within the CalendarSync module of the project.

classes.name: TestableCalendarSync
classes.description: A subclass of CalendarSync designed for unit testing, supporting dependency injection of test doubles, singleton state management, and accessor methods for testing the internal state.
